description: Architecture gates: a fast per-file pass after every edit, a full pass that refuses to end a red turn, a work-order guard that keeps an edit inside its declared paths and warns on the wrong branch (the installed pre-commit hook is what actually refuses that commit), a Bash edit guard that reports a shell write outside those paths or on a protected branch, and a tool-call budget that makes a subagent hand off. Each no-ops without its own opt-in file.
